repository_scope.object: current executable finite theorem certificates for causal compression under open composition
allowed: declared grammars and controlled transition systems
formal ecological interpretation of model variables after theorem scope is stated
deterministic replay artifacts and regression tests
prohibited: parameter fitting or statistical estimation from observations
claims that a passing certificate validates an observed ecosystem
repository_scope.interpretation_boundary: Ecological mechanisms may motivate a declared state space or grammar in a separate application layer. This registry verifies only the current executable finite mathematical object. Source-relative minimal repair and history-aware transport belong to MLTR rather than the CCOC headline.

entries.title: Exact grammar-aware dynamic interface
entries.domain: A finite deterministic controlled system together with a fixed finite legal-action grammar.
entries.assumptions: The system, outputs, actions, and grammar are explicitly declared and finite.
entries.conclusion: The legal-word quotient is the coarsest exact interface preserving output, legal actions, and legal successors.
entries.non_claim: Fixed-grammar minimization itself is historically novel or the supplied grammar is automatically the correct ecological boundary contract.
entries.ecological_role: Formal object for a proposed ecological boundary summary after permissible interventions and exterior actions are declared.

entries.title: Addressable-completion lower bound and extension--compression noncommutation
entries.domain: A declared jointly realizable comparison family with explicit legal decoder words.
entries.assumptions: Relevant inside/exterior distinctions are jointly realizable and future-separable under the supplied open grammar; fixed contexts admit the stated closed factorization.
entries.conclusion: Exact open interface memory is bounded below by the operationally addressable comparison size, yielding a closed-to-open extension--compression gap even though each closed grammar may have its own small optimum.
entries.non_claim: Exterior memory adds in every composition without joint realization and operational separation; the result is not a source-relative repair theorem for a fixed inherited partition.
entries.ecological_role: Formalizes when independently future-separable outside processes force a larger minimum exact summary; it does not estimate those processes from field data.

entries.title: Bounded-local extremal sharpness realization
entries.domain: The declared binary/fixed-regular relay family and its bounded-degree compilation.
entries.assumptions: The relay topology, local grammar, pairwise protocol, and closed/open grammar contract are the supplied finite construction.
entries.conclusion: The construction realizes the closed/open interface separation with constant local grammar, pairwise messages, and maximum degree three; the strengthened family uses one newly legal primitive action.
entries.non_claim: Bounded degree alone forces interface inflation or the bounded-local realization package has established historical firstness.
entries.ecological_role: A locality-respecting mathematical witness, not a claim that ecological interaction networks implement the relay construction.

entries.title: Conservative exact portability boundary
entries.domain: Finite controlled systems with declared macro labels under composition or legal-action expansion.
entries.assumptions: Old macro meanings are preserved; equal macro labels have coherent successors; newly available actions have uniform availability and one macro successor inside each macro fiber.
entries.conclusion: One finite macro law/schema remains exact under the declared expansion when the coherence and conservative-action conditions hold.
entries.non_claim: These sufficient conditions are necessary for every portable macro-law or constitute a unique minimal repair theorem.
entries.ecological_role: Formal positive boundary supporting the CCOC lower-bound story; source-relative repair belongs to MLTR.

entries.title: Future-word and new-action fiber-split obstructions
entries.domain: A finite proposed macro fiber and a declared later legal word or newly legal action.
entries.assumptions: The supplied word or action is legal in the relevant later grammar and yields distinct output traces or successor labels from two states in one proposed fiber.
entries.non_claim: One split rules out every alternative macro-law, proves a global memory lower bound, or constructs the unique coarsest repair of an inherited source partition.
entries.ecological_role: A formal local warning supporting the CCOC obstruction picture; minimal inherited-law repair belongs to MLTR.
